note: Kinds assigned by this artifact, one per decision. The PR bodies do not classify their decisions; the grouping is a reading aid and loses nuance where a decision spans two kinds.

kinds.name: Placement & dependency direction
kinds.ask: Given what you know about the repo's future hosts, is this the right owner?

kinds.name: Interface shape
kinds.ask: Does the port name the real contract, or pre-build for a future that may not come?

kinds.name: State lifetime & transactions
kinds.ask: Walk one failure through it: what state is left behind?

kinds.name: Behavior & wire compatibility kept
kinds.ask: Is the preserved behavior still wanted, or is it a known defect carried forward?

kinds.name: Ordering & concurrency
kinds.ask: Two callers at once: does the stated order hold?

kinds.name: Enforcement & test seams
kinds.ask: Is the cost of the guard proportional to the rule it protects?

kinds.name: Where the PR was cut
kinds.ask: Would the other cut have been easier to review, or safer to land?
